authority: Rust match actor with authenticated seat-to-five-champions binding; no client-provided team/owner authority
consistency_rules: One active primary cast intent per actor/slot at seal; do not operate board, directional, targeted and kit queues concurrently for the same slot.
request_id replay with identical canonical payload returns identical cached ACK and never queues/casts/debits again; same request_id with different payload rejects.
Different request_id, same actor+slot before seal must reject with SLOT_ALREADY_PENDING unless a separately versioned explicit replacement protocol is implemented; after seal always immutable.

A sanctioned recast is a distinct explicit transition of the existing cast_instance_id and can occur within the same turn where skill design permits; never synthesize a new primary cast or second cost.
Validation (rank/CC/seat/fog/realm/range/resources/cooldown/target) and one atomic resource+CD commit precede spawning projectiles; track deterministic receipts.
Invalid, interrupted, superseded or completed intent transitions to Terminal and clears all old same-slot queue representations; cooldown expiry never resuscitates it.
Movement-to-range plans are distinct durable path orders; they cannot preserve a hidden unsealed cast that executes on cooldown expiry.
Visible team projections derive only filtered committed events; hidden targets, private intents, RNG and replay internals never leak through WASM.
Replay restore persists terminal command ids, cast_instance_id and state revisions so reconnect/retry cannot duplicate a debit or an impact.

resolver_precedence.desired: Resolved once against current authored registry with champion+slot+form+rank and explicit stage (board effect/targeted/directional/recast); legacy early adapter shortcuts are not authority.

ahri_e.legacy: queueKitSkillV42 forces queueDirectionalSkill; abilityRule kind=board_effect rejects. Direct board queue succeeds, mana 1000->940, creates authored temporal missile.
ahri_e.rust: route Ahri E exactly once via authored board projectile executor from normal user input
ahri_e.test_requirement: blue/red command->sealed->projectile->impact, no re-route or duplicate cost

ashe_r.legacy: One 100-mana board_temporal authored projectile. No immediate stun; collisions and terrain resolve on later simulated clock ticks.
ashe_r.rust: authoritative seeded integer tick flight + swept collisions + first champion impact CC; do not make stun instant to satisfy obsolete M14.
ashe_r.test_requirement: near/far clear line, obstacle suppression, spell-shield, blue/red, snapshot mid-flight

nami_w.legacy: Independent board and targeted pending queues, stale targeted W can cast after cooldown (S10 4/4 reproduced).
nami_w.rust: single-slot pending record, terminal cleanup and idempotent ACK; no ghost cast, regardless of queue order
nami_w.test_requirement: two seats x two order permutations x retry/reconnect and cooldown traversal

notes: No Rust gameplay changes in this audit branch. Snapshot hashes from legacy are not Rust parity hashes. Do not change the 22/2/2 S10 original-suite counts.
